question: In which year was the nationalisation of banks done by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1969**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **nationalization of banks** in India was carried out in **1969**. On **July 19, 1969**, the Government of India, under the leadership of then Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi**, nationalized 14 major commercial banks. 
 
• This move was aimed at aligning the banking sector with national priorities, increasing financial inclusion, and directing credit towards sectors such as agriculture, small industries, and rural development.
 
• The main objectives of the nationalization were:
 
 
• To provide banking services to a wider population, especially in rural and remote areas.
 
• To use the banking sector for economic planning and development.
 
• To ensure that the credit flow to priority sectors was not constrained by profit-driven motives.
 
 
 
• This was a significant step in India's economic history and laid the foundation for public sector dominance in the banking industry.
